artworks.title: Convoi Funèbre au Boulevard de Clichy (Funeral Procession on the Boulevard de Clichy)
artworks.medium: color etching, drypoint, aquatint, roulette, and softground, over heliogravure, hand-touched in watercolor and gold on turpentine soaked japan paper
artworks.description: The artwork features a bustling street scene at night. The composition shows various figures and a carriage moving along the street, which disappears into the distance lined with buildings. The sky includes a prominent moon, with a cloudy sky partially obscuring it. The artwork employs fine, expressive brushstrokes or etching lines, creating a sketch-like quality. The color palette consists of dark tones and sepia hues, giving a vintage and atmospheric effect. Some buildings show signage with the words "HOTEL MEUBLE" and "GARANCE CLECY."

artworks.title: The Lamentation
artworks.medium: gouache heightened with gold on vellum
artworks.description: The image depicts a painting of several individuals surrounding a central seated figure. The central figure is a man with long hair and a beard, slumped with wounds visible on his body. The surrounding individuals have solemn expressions and various postures of support and mourning. They are dressed in colorful robes with detailed textures. One person holds the central figure's hand while another kneels and holds his foot. The background shows a rocky landscape and trees against a blue sky.

artworks.title: Dawn in Luton Park
artworks.medium: watercolor and gouache with pen and ink over graphite on two sheets of joined laid paper; laid down on 19th-century mount
artworks.dimensions:
Overall: 32.9 x 76.2 cm (12 15/16 x 30 in.)
overall (mat size): 53.3 x 94 cm (21 x 37 in.)
artworks.description: The image shows a pastoral landscape with a low horizon blending with a distant tree line. The sky occupies the upper half with soft clouds. Cattle graze on the left under tall trees with a herder nearby. A cart is pulled by a farmer, a woman, and a child, suggesting movement. The brushstrokes are delicate and capture intricate foliage. The color palette consists of earth tones, greens, and sky blues, creating a harmonious atmosphere. Trees on the right frame the scene.

artworks.title: Conwy Castle, North Wales
artworks.medium: watercolor over graphite on cartridge paper
artworks.description: The image features a landscape view created in a watercolor style. Soft brushstrokes depict a serene scene with a horizon near the upper third of the image. A castle-like structure is on a green hill, with a path by calm waters in the foreground. A mountain looms in the background. The color palette includes earth tones like browns, greens, and greys with a pale blue sky. A tree with sparse branches leans into the scene from the left.

artworks.title: Changing Horses at a Post House in France
artworks.medium: watercolor over black ink and graphite on wove paper
artworks.description: This is a painting of a chaotic scene at a horse post station. A group of horses are being led and prepared by several individuals in front of a rustic building. The building's sign reads "Poste au Chevaux." The scene is bustling with activity; some figures engage with the horses, who seem agitated. In the background, an elegant coach with two figures inside is being tended to, while another person appears to be gesturing animatedly. Trees frame the building. The style is light and humorous, with a fluid use of lines and earthy colors, capturing the essence of travel and countryside life. This is in the style of Thomas Rowlandson.

artworks.title: Adrian Beverland Drawing from a Statue
artworks.artist: Isaak Beckett after Simon du Bois
artworks.dimensions: sheet (cut inside platemark): 42.4 x 25 cm (16 11/16 x 9 13/16 in.)
artworks.description: The image shows the upper three-quarters of a person's body. The person is depicted sitting or kneeling on a platform, looking towards the viewer, with thick, curly hair cascading down past their shoulders. Their facial features are distinct, with a calm expression. They wear a flowing garment with detailed folds and cuffs. The person is leaning on a book, which rests on their lap atop a stack of several large books. In the background, there is a statue of a nude figure with their back facing the viewer, standing on a pedestal adorned with decorative elements. The setting includes large stone structures, obelisks, and what appears to be an Egyptian influence with hieroglyphics. The sky is filled with clouds.

artworks.title: The Right Honorable Elizabeth Countess of Northumberland
artworks.artist: Isaak Beckett after Sir Peter Lely
artworks.description: The image shows a seated woman in a half-body view, reclining against a stone structure. Her curly hair cascades over her shoulders. She wears an elaborate dress with puffed sleeves and a low neckline, holding a bouquet of flowers in her left hand. A bracelet adorns her right wrist. The background shows lush foliage, two putti sculptures, and large classical columns.

artworks.title: Philip Mercier
artworks.artist: John Faber II after Philip Mercier
artworks.description: The image is a portrait of a man looking directly at the viewer. He has a prominent nose and a calm expression. The man wears a patterned cap with floral designs, a robe-like garment with large buttons and tassels, and a scarf around his neck. He is holding a palette and paintbrushes. In the background are shelves with many books.

artworks.title: Mrs. Margaret Woffington in the Character of Mrs. Ford in the Merry Wives of Windsor
artworks.artist: John Faber II after Edward Haytley
artworks.description: The image shows an illustration of a woman standing outdoors. She is wearing a dark, long dress with decorative lace and an apron. The woman has a hat with lace or feather embellishments and her arms are crossed in front of her. In the background, there is a scenic landscape with trees, rolling hills, and a clear sky.

artworks.title: Edmund Halley
artworks.artist: George White after Sir Godfrey Kneller
artworks.description: The image displays a portrait of a person from the chest up, facing forward with a slight turn to the right. The individual has distinct facial features and long, curly, white hair. They wear a dark coat with a vest, a white neck scarf, and the clothing has visible buttons. The background is a shaded oval shape. Below the portrait, there is text in a decorative script that includes the name "Edmundus Halley."

artworks.title: The Wing
artworks.creditLine: Gift of the Anne and Jacques Baruch Collection
artworks.description: This is a drawing of an outstretched wing. The drawing shows a detailed study of a single large wing spanning from the bottom left to the top right of the page. It is shaded to bring out the texture and volume of the feathers, and executed with fine shading and cross-hatching. Grid lines are lightly sketched across the paper. The overall tone is soft with emphasis on the wing's natural curve.

artworks.title: Stary Hrosenov
artworks.creditLine: Gift of the Anne and Jacques Baruch Collection
artworks.description: The image shows a countryside setting with a thatched-roof dwelling to the center-left. The horizon is indicated by the line of the roof and the distant greenery behind the house. The brushstrokes suggest movement and texture, with dappled shadow patches on the ground and against the house. The foreground has varying shades of green, hints of brown, and wood textures. The color palette is earthy and natural, dominated by greens, browns, and soft yellows, with a touch of red worn by a figure walking beyond the house. The sky is mostly obscured, but the light suggests a bright day.

artworks.title: Landscape with Ruin
artworks.creditLine: Gift of the Anne and Jacques Baruch Collection
artworks.description: The image displays a natural scene with stone ruins covered by foliage. There is no visible horizon. The artwork appears to be a watercolor painting with soft brushstrokes creating a delicate texture. A terrain with stones and green vegetation leads to the ruins, which are surrounded by greenery. A tall tree with a twisting trunk is on the left, branches reaching into the sky. The color palette includes muted earth tones, enhancing the serene atmosphere. The background has subtle gray and beige hues, fading into the distant landscape.

artworks.title: Skittle Players
artworks.creditLine: Gift of the Anne and Jacques Baruch Collection
artworks.description: The image features a geometric arrangement of rectangles and arches filled with patterns. The upper section shows intricate patterns resembling floral motifs and gold ovals against a deep blue background. Below, there is a scene with putti surrounding a pig in a playful barnyard tableau. The figures emerge from a backdrop of stylized foliage.

artworks.title: The Apostles
artworks.creditLine: Gift of the Anne and Jacques Baruch Collection
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a group of twelve figures in flowing robes, captured in various gestures. The scene depicts them against a background of trees and an ambiguous sky. The linework and shading emphasize the draped fabric and postures, creating a sense of movement and intention among the figures. This is in the style of Albrecht Dürer.

artworks.title: Salonek
artworks.creditLine: Gift of the Anne and Jacques Baruch Collection
artworks.description: The image shows an arrangement of lines and intricate patterns on a vertical canvas. There are horizontal bands of varying thickness at the top, filled with floral patterns resembling intertwining vines and blossoms. Below, there are ornate motifs reminiscent of lacework or decorative ironwork. The lower two-thirds feature a field of muted blue with small scattered shapes resembling petals. The bottom border consists of symmetrical shapes, similar to decorative tiling on a wall.

artworks.title: Design for Breakfront
artworks.creditLine: Gift of the Anne and Jacques Baruch Collection
artworks.description: The image shows a wooden cabinet with shelves and drawers filled with decorative objects like vases and cups. It has intricate carvings and a color palette of beige, brown, blue, and gold. The cabinet is centered, with symmetrical arrangements of decorative items, including urns on each side of a central alcove with a sculpture. The lower half features drawers and cabinets with butterfly patterns.

artworks.title: Draft for Diploma of Jindricka Mastalko
artworks.creditLine: Gift of the Anne and Jacques Baruch Collection
artworks.description: The image shows two figures against a plain background with faint hints of distant landscapes. The figure on the left is an elderly man standing and facing right, holding a bouquet of flowers. The figure on the right is a young boy seated on the ledge of an engraved structure, reaching towards the elderly man. The background contains sketch-like ornamentation and script, with a faint illustration of a distant town or castle on a hill.

artworks.title: Vapenice
artworks.creditLine: Gift of the Anne and Jacques Baruch Collection
artworks.description: The image shows a pastoral landscape with cottages in the distance, hills marking the horizon, and a person lying down in the foreground. The sketch is done in pencil with a textured style and monochromatic color palette, depicting a tranquil countryside scene.

artworks.title: A Rose-Breasted Finch Hanging from a Nail
artworks.medium: watercolor and gouache on vellum on old mount
artworks.description: The image shows a bird hanging upside down by a piece of twine tied to its foot and a nail. The bird has plumage with soft pink, white, grey, and black colors. The background is dark brown, and a fly is visible to the left of the bird. The bird is in the center of the image, with its wings and tail feathers extending outward, while the nail and twine are at the top.

artworks.title: A Sculptor in His Atelier
artworks.description: The image displays four people standing in an artist's studio. The individuals are arranged in a semi-circle, focusing on each other. The man on the left wears a hat, cape, and trousers, with long curly hair. The person next to him appears to be a woman with long, curly hair wearing an elaborate dress with lace details. Next to her, another man with curly, shoulder-length hair is dressed in a striped doublet and breeches. They are observing a small sculpture held by the man on the right, who is not wearing a hat. He wears similar styled attire, with detailed clothing and boots. Around the scene are various sculptures and artistic materials. A large nude statue of a woman and cherub is positioned on a pedestal to the right. Shelves in the background are filled with various sculptures, including busts and figures. A large window on the left side brings in light, casting shadows across the floor and figures. The room has a high ceiling and is constructed with large stone blocks. Tools and small sculptures are displayed on tables under the window, emphasizing the artist's workspace.

artworks.title: A Newhaven Fisherwoman
artworks.artist: David Octavius Hill and Robert Adamson
artworks.description: The image depicts a woman posing confidently, with her left hand on her hip and her right hand against a stone wall. Her face is partially shadowed, but her hair is neatly pulled back. She wears a knee-length striped skirt and a light-colored blouse with voluminous sleeves. A large woven basket is beside her. The background is a textured stone wall.

artworks.title: James Drummond
artworks.artist: David Octavius Hill and Robert Adamson
artworks.description: The image shows a man from the knees up, in a leaning position with his left elbow resting on a fabric-covered surface, and his hand supporting his head. He has a thoughtful expression on his face, with downcast eyes and dark hair that is combed to the sides. He is wearing a light-colored suit with a matching vest and a white shirt underneath, topped with a dark bow tie. His right hand is holding a book, which he rests on one knee. The background consists of patterned fabric, possibly curtains, and a wooden lattice, with ornamental details visible on the left side, including a vase and furniture.

artworks.title: Sanctus Bernhardinus
artworks.description: The image shows an elderly man standing in a robe, facing slightly to the right. He has a halo with rays around his head and holds a stick in his left hand and a radiant sun emblem with the letters "IHS" in his right hand. A flying dove carrying a cross hovers near his head. A smaller figure is kneeling in front of him and holds a key-like object. Several mitres are at his feet, and the background is plain.
